item_name: Rothco Steel Half Face Mask With Ear Guard - Black
item_short_desc: Rothco’s lightweight and reliable Steel Half Face Mask with Ear Guard provides all-encompassing facial protection that insulates your face and ears while playing airsoft.
description: Rothco’s lightweight and reliable Steel Half Face Mask with Ear Guard provides all-encompassing facial protection that insulates your face and ears while playing airsoft. The half face mask features a carbon mesh steel cage that covers your mouth and nose, while additional carbon mesh steel covers surround your ears. The adjustable elastic straps make for an airsoft mask that comfortably fits most head sizes. The incredibly breathable carbon mesh prevents excessive heat and enables east communication. Wear with a pair of airsoft goggles for complete facial protection. For airsoft use only.
